stories.title: AI complicates proof of life in the search for Savannah Guthrie's mother
stories.summary: The FBI says AI is complicating the idea of a proof of life message in the search for Savannah Guthrie's mom. Experts say AI needs just a few short clips of a person to render a convincing fake.

stories.title: In Lebanon, a college campus welcomes cats abandoned in war
stories.summary: At the American University of Beirut where up to 1,600 rescued cats roam the campus.

stories.title: Modest 'mental exercise' can reduce risk of dementia for decades, study finds
stories.summary: One type of cognitive training appears to reduce the risk of dementia 20 years later.

stories.title: In Oregon, a dog competition tries to get more dogs into truffle hunting
stories.summary: Organizers of a truffle dog championship for amateurs in Oregon hope it will draw more people to truffle hunting with dogs, which some experts say could improve the Pacific Northwest's truffle crop.

stories.title: This really is U.S. biathlon's year
stories.summary: Biathlon is the only winter Olympic sport in which the U.S. has never medaled. But this year, the U.S. has the two standout biathletes and a coach who grew up on the doorstep of the Olympic venue.

stories.title: Watching Bad Bunny's Super Bowl show in Puerto Rico
stories.summary: In San Juan, Puerto Rico, we watched the Super Bowl halftime show with the audience Bad Bunny has represented since his start: his fellow Puerto Ricans.
